title: Training children in extraocular vision in Mexico and Spain

tellings.quote: there's the whole group's training children to do this in Mexico and in Spain and I don't know whether there's much happening in the US or Britain but I know about it from Spain because I have a colleague in Spain who's working on this

plain: A scientist named Rupert Sheldrake told podcast host Jesse Michels that groups in Mexico and Spain are training children in extraocular vision, which means seeing without using the eyes. He says he knows about the work in Spain through a colleague there who is doing it, and he is not sure whether anything like it is happening in the US or Britain. If true, it would suggest this ability can be taught.
